rationale: The evidence shows Teleport user carol.tan@eproc.test connecting as dba outside of their usual active hours and temporarily escalating the analyst_ro role to SUPERUSER. While the privilege was subsequently reverted, this unauthorized escalation poses a severe security risk and warrants immediate containment. Locking the specific Teleport user will terminate their active sessions and prevent further access without affecting other administrators. No SQL action is needed since the role's privileges were already reverted.
rollback: IRREVERSIBLE: Teleport lock creation generates a dynamic UUID. An administrator must manually identify the lock name using 'tctl get locks' and remove it using 'tctl rm lock/<lock-name>'.

alert_summary.rule_name: Role altered to SUPERUSER or CREATEROLE

evidence.statement: SELECT rolname, rolsuper FROM pg_roles ORDER BY rolsuper DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT rolname, rolsuper FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'analyst_ro'

baseline_context.note: Role dba normally returns about 372 rows per simulated day across the 14-day baseline, almost all inside 08:00-17:00.
